name: Clear Guide
instruct: An original adult narrator with a clear middle register, conversational pacing, precise diction and a calm direct tone. Not breathy or theatrical.
text: A useful idea becomes clearer when each sentence has room to breathe.

name: Warm Storyteller
instruct: An original adult storyteller with a warm low register, gently varied rhythm, rounded vowels and restrained energy. Not whispering or imitating a named person.
text: The little boat followed the river until the trees opened onto a quiet lake.
